Class ViewUpdater

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Network.ViewUpdater
public class ViewUpdater extends Object
Bridges the controller/model layer to the view layer. Maintains a list of GameEventListener instances and broadcasts game notifications to all of them.

All notify methods build immutable data from the model and broadcast it. ViewUpdater never holds a persistent reference to the model; it receives it as a parameter when a full snapshot is needed.

    • ViewUpdater

      public ViewUpdater()
      Constructs a new ViewUpdater. Initializes a thread-safe list of listeners to prevent concurrent modification exceptions during network broadcasts.

      public void notifyMatchSuspended(String soleSurvivorNickname)
      Broadcasts that the match has been suspended because a single player is left connected (FA3). Sent as an informational ErrorMessage with code SUSPENDED, which existing views already render as a notice.

      public void notifyMatchResumed()

    • notifyGameOver

      public void notifyGameOver(GameModel model, String endMessage)
      Ends the game and broadcasts a GameOverMessage carrying the final snapshot. Used by FA3 when the sole-survivor timeout expires.
      Parameters:
      model - the current game model (its phase should already be GAME_OVER)
      endMessage - a human-readable summary of how the game ended
